title: Just added weapon sprites and enchantment animations to my AI solo dev auto-play ROG “VELSCOUR”!  Come give it a try.  It’s fun, addictive, and free.  It’s also HUGE.
author: batmessiah
selftext:
[https://agilancer.github.io/velscour/](https://agilancer.github.io/velscour/)

Come join us over on r/VELSCOUR !

I‘ve been working on this game for a few weeks now, and have a small following.  One of our players recently made his own multiplayer variant hosted on his personal server as well.  It’s free to play and has full auto play as well.   I’m constantly updating the game, and always open to constructive criticism.  No, I’m not going to animate the sprites, at least not any time soon.  It’s part of the aesthetic anyways, having to work within my constraints.  Anyways, come join us, I recently added cloud saves via google, tons of story missions, new biomes, end game dungeons and objectives, and more!

  
Adding weapons to everyone was a bit of a challenge this late in the development cycle, but I made it work!  I love how my lancer is looking here!  So sick!
